claimMap.exactSentence: Pharmacy First for Worsbrough
This page explains how people in Worsbrough can use Pharmacy First at Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic.
You can decide whether to contact the pharmacy for eligible common conditions.
Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic is located 5.3 km from Worsbrough at 91 Snape Hill Rd, Darfield, Barnsley S73 9LR.
Healthcare and pharmacy options in Worsbrough
Worsbrough is served by local GP practices such as Dr C Liley - Worsbrough Health Centre the Dove Valley Practice and The Kakoty Practice Worsbrough.
These practices help shape the healthcare landscape for residents.
For Pharmacy First, you may choose to use Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic in Darfield, which is outside the immediate Worsbrough area.
People in Worsbrough can reach the pharmacy by travelling to Darfield.
If you think Pharmacy First may be suitable, you can call Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic on 01226 210477 before visiting to check how consultations are being arranged.
How far is Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic from Worsbrough?
The pharmacy is 5.3 km from Worsbrough, located in Darfield.
When should I use another healthcare route?
If you have urgent or severe symptoms such as breathing difficulties, chest pain, severe dehydration, confusion, a non-blanching rash, or feel critically unwell, seek urgent medical care.
What happens during a Pharmacy First consultation?
The pharmacist will review your symptoms, medicines, and any red-flag concerns.
Outcomes may include treatment, self-care advice, or referral if needed.
What should I bring to my consultation?
Bring a list of your current medicines and be ready to describe your symptoms.
Contact the pharmacy to discuss your needs or arrange an appointment.
